description: This file defines the Subscriptions interface, which manages a collection of local subscriptions for a pub/sub system, including methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, counting, and exporting subscription data.

classes.name: Subscriptions
classes.description: An interface for managing local subscriptions, providing methods to query, modify, and export subscription data.

methods.name: countTopics
methods.description: Returns the total number of topics that have active subscriptions.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an actor subscribes to any topic.

methods.name: streamSubscribers
methods.description: Provides a stream of ActorRef objects representing subscribers to a given topic.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a subscriber to a set of topics with an optional filter for message topic selection.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes subscriptions for a subscriber from specified topics.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber and all associated subscriptions.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates an unmodifiable copy of the subscription data for sharing.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports an approximation of current subscription data suitable for cluster broadcast, optionally forcing an update.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no subscribers or topics with active subscriptions.
